put.description:
No API Key is required. Send every returned uploadUrl header and exactly Content-Length bytes. The ticket is valid for 60 seconds at admission; the upload intent retains its own expiry. An identical repeated PUT returns the same ready File. Replay the original create request and Idempotency-Key to obtain a fresh URL. get.description:
Anonymous, ticket-authorized endpoint for every authenticated download resource kind. Returns complete same-path inline bytes or an HTTPS Drive9 storage redirect with bounded presign exposure. Organization-issued Drive tickets require their exact issuing credential to remain current at new redemption admission; revoked or rotated issuers return 404. An admitted transfer may finish within existing limits. A returned provider URL retains its own expiry and is not revoked by this core check. Legacy unattributed v3.drive tickets are refused; obtain a fresh ticket.

Authorization: short-lived download ticket; no API Key required.

HardwareCredentialAuth.description: Hardware Credential authenticates only one inventoried device on /api/v1/hardware/connect. It grants no User, Session or management authority. Send it in Authorization, never in a URL.

ConnectorKeyAuth.description: Connector Key authenticates only tunnel connections on /api/v1/connectors/ws. It identifies one Organization-owned Connector and grants no End User, Session or management authority. Send it in Authorization, never in a URL.

UserApiKey.description: Opaque ti_user_<id>_<secret> credential: ASCII alphanumeric id body (1–64), unpadded base64url secret (43 characters from 32 random bytes). Authenticates the bound User and Organization. The persisted key owner determines scope.

OrganizationApiKey.description: Opaque ti_org_<id>_<secret> credential: ASCII alphanumeric id body (1–64), unpadded base64url secret (43 characters from 32 random bytes). Authenticates an Organization machine principal with no acting User. Each handler explicitly chooses whether to admit this principal kind.
